contract.geometry: byte-semantic accessor match to the approved quantized monolithic candidate
contract.compressedTarget: opaque ETC1S to ETC1/ETC2 RGB at 4 bpp; UASTC to ASTC/BC7/ETC2 RGBA at 8 bpp
contract.fallback: RGBA8 when the device exposes no supported compressed texture target
contract.decoder: Three KTX2Loader, initialized only by the WebGL renderer
